records.desired_effect: Evaluate bounded Genie3 site-conditioned and ESMFold2 unconditioned replacement-generator routes under the frozen CEACAM5 target-recovery and site-contact gates.
records.rationale: The replacement campaign tested whether fast cloud generators could recover the locked tusamitamab extracellular footprint after FreeBindCraft produced no promotable artifact, while preserving explicit route limitations and stop gates.
principal_risks: The Genie3 trace recovered the requested site footprint but failed the frozen target-coordinate lock, so sequence filling and scale generation were not allowed.
ESMFold2 was unconditioned and generated exploratory folds rather than target-site-conditioned binders; all three failed the frozen site-contact gate.
None of the four structures was promoted or shown to bind CEACAM5.

records.desired_effect: Record the completed FAP/6Y0F charge-aware docking screen as a hypothesis-generation handoff; do not infer affinity or inhibition.
records.rationale: The deposited linagliptin pocket supplied a locked extracellular FAP chain-A control and passed the unchanged redocking gate after charge-aware receptor preparation.
principal_risks: Docking scores and pose geometry are computational hypotheses only.
The five confirmation passers retain reactivity, aggregation, solubility, and assay-interference review flags where recorded.
No measured binding, target engagement, or disease efficacy is established.

records.desired_effect: Recover the deposited B6_BP_dslf footprint as a target-conditioned positive control for the structure-to-design lane.

site.evidence: Ten beta-6 residues were selected deterministically from the heavy-atom contact network observed between target chains A/B and deposited minibinder chain C in RCSB 8TCG. The complete 33-residue target footprint and all 60 residue contact pairs remain in the interface artifact.
excluded_regions: nonpolymer glycans and metal ions in the RFdiffusion3 compatibility input
site.numbering_scheme: RCSB author numbering mapped to sequential campaign numbering per target chain
uncertain_regions: alpha-v chain A contributes 11 observed interface residues but is retained as receptor context rather than a conditioning-hotspot chain

records.rationale: The deposited target-minibinder complex supplies an exact public reference geometry for testing target preparation, conditioning, artifact transport, and interface recovery before disease-opportunity fan-out.
principal_risks: A recovered reference footprint validates geometric conditioning and transport; it does not establish binding affinity, selectivity, or therapeutic activity.
The beta-6 conditioning subset represents an interface that also contacts alpha-v chain A.
constraints: Retain both target chains A and B in every generated complex.
Use the beta-6 hotspot set from the packaged reference-interface measurements.
Score recovery against the complete deposited A/B target footprint as well as the beta-6 conditioning subset.
Reject outputs that do not contact the locked beta-6 site.

negative: the same target preparation with hotspot conditioning removed
a size-matched off-site beta-6 surface patch
positive: RCSB 8TCG deposited B6_BP_dslf chain C interface

records.claim_ceiling: completed computational geometry-recovery screen with no promoted generated candidate
